heading: Process lifecycle
body: In the default process mode, Tachyon starts one process for each request, and a supervisor watches it. The process reads the request, writes its response or its limited stream, and then exits. Tachyon caches prepared sources and compiled artifacts by their content (content-addressed caching). Execution uses a private runtime staging area (a folder where Tachyon prepares code to run). Cache locations are internal details. They are not paths in your application to import or edit. The source, the prelude and the compilation identity decide when Tachyon reuses a cached item. The prelude is code that Tachyon adds before your source. Java still starts from source. It is not compiled ahead of time into a native executable. The supervisor enforces deadlines, concurrency limits and frame limits. Optional isolation drivers are a separate deployment policy.
